verdict.rationale: Scoped third-party access is a fair axis for cap table software, so it applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of delegated access, role-based permissions, scoped API tokens, or advisor/vendor seats that would let law firms, HRIS vendors or wealth managers see a limited slice of equity data. Exporting the cap table to Excel and the admin dashboard are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not scoped delegated access, and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As a developer, third parties my company authorizes — law firms, HRIS vendors, wealth managers — can access scoped slices of equity data on our behalf without full admin credentials
